reason: Identity was authenticated via name+zip, but the candidate action retrieves order #W1845024 without first confirming with the user which order corresponds to the 'home office stuff' items they want to return. More critically, the policy requires checking order status before acting and the user has not yet specified which order or confirmed item-level details; fetching order details is a read-only info step, which is generally permitted post-authentication, but the user only has three orders and none has been identified as containing the office items. There is no explicit prohibition on calling get_order_details, but proceeding without any indication of which order matches the user's description leaves material ambiguity about whether this is the correct order to act on before further steps (return) are proposed. Given get_order_details is read-only and non-mutating, this alone is low risk, but since no order was specified by the user and the agent is guessing among three, human clarification or explicit selection should occur first.
